## Types

### type Application

```go
type Application struct {

	// nodeKey -> last rebirth request the application made itself
	// nodeKey -> a request was throttled while one was pending
	// nodeKey -> last NDEATH
	// nodeKey -> messages ahead of their sequence
	// nodeKey -> current session
	// nodeKey -> pending wait for an NBIRTH
	// sessionWait, shorter in tests
	// lateBirthWait, shorter in tests

}
```

Application is a Sparkplug B Application (non-primary-host consumer). It subscribes to the Sparkplug namespace, tracks node/device state, resolves aliases, and can send NCMD/DCMD commands — but never publishes STATE.

GetNode returns a snapshot of what is known about an edge node, or nil. The snapshot is a copy: it does not change as messages arrive, and reading it needs no locking.

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	BrokerURL  string
	ClientID   string
	ServerURLs []string

	// Username and Password log in to every broker. A Password needs a
	// Username. They are passed to the transport and never logged; use TLS,
	// since MQTT carries them in clear.
	Username string
	Password string

	Logger        sparkplugb.Logger
	Metrics       Metrics
	OnState       StateHandler
	OnNodeBirth   NodeHandler
	OnDeviceBirth DeviceHandler
	OnNodeData    NodeHandler
	OnDeviceData  DeviceHandler
	OnNodeDeath   NodeEventHandler
	OnDeviceDeath DeviceEventHandler
}
```

Config configures a Sparkplug B Application. Unlike a Host Application, an Application does not publish STATE messages and is not a Primary Host. It subscribes to spBv1.0/#, tracks edge nodes and devices, and can send commands.

### type Metrics

```go
type Metrics interface {
	OnConnect(brokerURL string, d time.Duration, err error)
	OnMessage(messageType string)
	OnStateChange(old, new State)
	OnNodeBirth(groupID, nodeID string)
	OnNodeDeath(groupID, nodeID string)
}
```

Metrics receives the events of an application, to count and time them: set it as Config.Metrics. Each method is called synchronously from the goroutines of the application: they must be safe for concurrent use, quick, and must not block. Embed NopMetrics to implement only some.
